name: ENSData (ENS name and reverse-record resolution API)
operator: ENSData (ensdata.net, independent community service for the Ethereum Name Service)
tier_rationale: Long-running community API for the Ethereum Name Service with public documentation (ensdata.net) and an identifiable project site; council decision P209 cond 3 'Registry provider ensdata: tier community, terms open' (A8 community).

reliability.justification: Resolves public ENS records from the Ethereum chain; the resolution itself is reliable, but text records (twitter, github, url, email) are self-asserted by the ENS owner and never verified (P209 cond 2).

api.title: ENSData API GET /{name}.eth (forward resolution) and GET /{0xaddress} (reverse record / primary name)

terms.quote: Registry provider ensdata: tier community, terms open (council-1 P209 cond 3, binding council text; ENSData is a free public API without key or published restrictions).

api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P209 cond 3); research C0491 verified_live 200 (2026-11-26). 404 {'error': true, 'status': 404, 'message': 'Unable to resolve ... not registered ...'} = name not registered, or no reverse record for an address: EMPTY, never an absent wallet (P209 cond 1); 400 'Invalid ENS name' for names the provider rejects. Served by Cloudflare in front of Railway; no rate-limit headers and no published limit (undocumented): min_interval 1 s, 24 h cache. Text records are self-asserted by the ENS owner (P209 cond 2). Used by ens_resolver.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G09-1 (P209). Only .eth names and 0x addresses are sent (ordinary DNS domains never). No published rate limit or quota: no quota block, politeness 1 s per request.
